verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents a natural-language agent that issues code commands, works across the editor, terminal and browser, and delegates test runs and codebase searches to subagents. These are the core ingredients of natural-language troubleshooting, but no evidence names debugging or troubleshooting as a documented workflow. Missing for 10: explicit debugging/troubleshooting documentation (e.g., error diagnosis, stack-trace analysis, debugger integration), independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging via natural-language queries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries
